name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases at 4,852 (29 Oct), more than double 2025; elimination status at risk
state: The CDC reported 4,852 confirmed US measles cases as of 29 Oct, more than double 2025's total, with three deaths. Analysts say the US is highly likely to lose its measles elimination status this autumn (CIDRAP). The next CDC update is due this week; no change as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Check that you and your children are up to date with MMR vaccination, especially before travel.
rubric_hit: Large outbreak in a high-income country = Watch

sources.title: CIDRAP — US highly likely to lose measles elimination status

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
